evidence.notes: DISTANCE with GEOLOCATION filters, orders, and projects local Apex SOQL rows.

source.content: @isTest private class QueryRuntimeSOQLSOSLGeolocationDistanceTest { @isTest static void distanceFiltersAndOrdersRows() { Account near = new Account(Name = 'Near'); near.put('PrimaryLocation__Latitude__s', 37.775); near.put('PrimaryLocation__Longitude__s', -122.418); Account acrossTown = new Account(Name = 'Across Town'); acrossTown.put('PrimaryLocation__Latitude__s', 37.8044); acrossTown.put('PrimaryLocation__Longitude__s', -122.2712); Account far = new Account(Name = 'Far'); far.put('PrimaryLocation__Latitude__s', 34.0522); far.put('PrimaryLocation__Longitude__s', -118.2437); insert new List<Account>{ near, acrossTown, far }; List<Account> rows = Database.query('SELECT Name, DISTANCE(GEOLOCATION(PrimaryLocation__Latitude__s, PrimaryLocation__Longitude__s), GEOLOCATION(37.775,-122.418), \'mi\') miles FROM Account WHERE DISTANCE(GEOLOCATION(PrimaryLocation__Latitude__s, PrimaryLocation__Longitude__s), GEOLOCATION(37.775,-122.418), \'mi\') < 20 ORDER BY DISTANCE(GEOLOCATION(PrimaryLocation__Latitude__s, PrimaryLocation__Longitude__s), GEOLOCATION(37.775,-122.418), \'mi\')'); System.assertEquals(2, rows.size()); System.assertEquals('Near', rows[0].Name); System.assertEquals('Across Town', rows[1].Name); System.assertEquals(0, (Decimal)rows[0].get('miles')); } }
